request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
explanation: Counts public symbols of each kind in non-test files under auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/, excluding its tests/ subfolder. It relies on the is_public flag, which already excludes underscore-prefixed names and members of private classes, and filters out nested definitions via the <locals> marker in qualnames.
sql: SELECT s.kind AS kind, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS public_count FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE f.is_test = FALSE AND s.is_public = TRUE AND s.kind IN ('class','function','method') AND (f.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' OR f.file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo') AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' AND s.qualname NOT LIKE '%<locals>%' AND (s.kind <> 'method' OR s.qualname LIKE '%._%' = FALSE) GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY s.kind
